notes.corpus_fit: Does not meet the schema's sampling frame on three counts: (1) three lenders sign, but all are Sylebra Capital affiliated funds, so this is functionally a bilateral insider loan; (2) $150M is at the floor of the $150M-$5B band; (3) no margin grid keyed to leverage or ratings. Added to the corpus as a documented exception in 0a71c23, because it is the only empty-covenant case available; all three deviations are recorded in corpus.md under 'Document 16'.
notes.facility_name: §2.01 labels the loans 'Revolving Loans'; the tranche itself is the defined term 'Revolving Facility'. 'Facility' means the Revolving Facility. Only one facility exists — no term loan, no L/C or swingline sublimit, no incremental/accordion. Field is no longer scored (cut at Kontoor); retained as a record.
notes.aggregate_commitment: Recitals also state 'an aggregate amount of up to $150,000,000'. Schedule 1.01(b) (lender-by-lender commitments) is not attached to the filed exhibit, so no schedule-vs-definition check possible. §2.06(b) provides for automatic permanent reduction dollar-for-dollar for Indebtedness under §7.02(f) above $50,000,000 — post-closing mechanic, does not change closing commitment.
notes.maturity_date: June 30, 2024 is a Sunday. The definition adjusts to the next preceding Business Day, so the operative maturity is Friday, June 28, 2024. Recorded the stated calendar date; the Business Day proviso is a mechanical adjustment like the 'earliest of' limbs, not an alternative maturity. Flag: schema.md does not state the Business Day convention explicitly, though labeling-guide.md does and the rule for maturity basis added under Extreme Networks relies on it. Third document in the corpus where it arises (Amentum, Lamb Weston EX-10.2, this). No springing maturity proviso.
notes.interest_rate_benchmark: §2.01: 'Revolving Loans will be Term SOFR Loans' — Term SOFR is the only pricing option; Base Rate is defined but used only in the §3.03 fallback. The 'Term SOFR' definition bakes in the SOFR Adjustment (CSA of 10/15/25 bps by tenor); adjusted variant maps to term_sofr per rule.
notes.applicable_margin_bps: Opening margin is 5.00% from Closing Date through June 30, 2023 → 500 bps. Not deferred, not silent. CSA (SOFR Adjustment) is inside the Term SOFR definition and excluded from the margin per rule. Known limitation: 500 bps is the correct opening value under the rule but describes only the first three and a half months of a fifteen-month facility, after which the margin escalates to 1750 bps. The field records an opening margin and this document is the case where that is least representative of the economics.
notes.has_margin_grid: AUDITED 2026-09-11, CORRECTED true -> false. 'Applicable Margin' occurs exactly twice in the document: its definition and its single use in §2.08(a). The margin varies only with the calendar (5.00% -> 10.00% -> 12.50% -> 15.00% -> 17.50%, on fixed dates), not with any measured condition. Zero occurrences of: Pricing Level, Pricing Grid, Leverage Ratio, utilization, ratings-keyed pricing, or any compliance-certificate reset (no Compliance Certificate is defined at all). 'Debt Rating' appears once, undefined, in the §6.03(f) notice covenant — template residue, not pricing. Commitment fee is a flat 0.25% (no fee grid either, unlike Paya). This is a time-based escalator, not a grid. It is a genuine no-grid document, but it is NOT a flat-margin document: record it as 'escalator, no grid' in the corpus table, not alongside Paya's flat pricing. Proposed rule for schema.md: a margin that changes only with the passage of time (escalator/step-up on fixed dates) is has_margin_grid=false; the schedule is noted in free text. Rationale: every 'true' example in the rule is contingent on a fact that must be observed about the borrower; a calendar is certain at signing; and the applicable_margin_bps rules (opening level until first compliance certificate; silent -> highest level) presuppose a compliance-measured grid.
notes.financial_covenants: Confirmed empty. §6.12, §7.11 and §7.12 are all [Reserved]. Article VII contains only incurrence-style negative covenants (liens, indebtedness, investments, etc.). No leverage, coverage, liquidity or capex test anywhere; no Compliance Certificate is defined or required. Zero occurrences of EBITDA in the document. Not a labeling gap.
notes.fees_not_labeled: Commitment fee 0.25% p.a. on undrawn (flat, no grid); upfront fee 0.75% of Commitments (§2.09). Default Rate = +2.00%.
